prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Preset Style Fallback Flow for Custom Pet Creation: Introduce a curated visual preset selector step when photo upload fails or generates unintended custom pet aesthetics. (why: Custom pet generation failure and bad rendering accounts for 3 support tickets, contributing to the lowest conversion step (adoption at 60.9%).)
1: [home, hint] System Tray Spawn Guidance and Display Warning: Add an explicit system tray tip and status hint to the waiting screen for users whose security software hides desktop overlay windows. (why: Support received multiple tickets where pets failed to appear on desktop or app seemed stuck on opening.)
2: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Name Input and Badge Reward: Add an interactive name prompt and animated official badge directly on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption has the highest friction and drop-off (60.9% conversion, median 89s / mean 1017s); adding ownership milestone elements boosts completion.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Time Estimate and Push Notification Toggle: Enable desktop readiness notifications and display a real-time progress timer on the waiting screen. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing users to abandon the app while generation finishes.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Pet Gesture and Voice Testing Playground: Add a pre-desktop playground screen where users try pet gestures and voice commands in a sandbox before final setup. (why: Post-onboarding users struggle to understand pet controls and interaction features, leading to early churn.)

scores.note: Adoption has the lowest conversion (60.9%) and explicit support tickets highlight custom creation failures.
Addresses multiple tickets regarding hidden tray overlays on the home waiting step.
Targets the highest drop-off step (adoption) with motivation, though support mail doesn't explicitly ask for it.
Directly targets extreme wait times (mean 2336s) on home step to reduce background abandonment.
Adding a full sandbox screen increases onboarding length, despite post-onboarding benefit.
